# Cloudflare Insights
> Cloudflare Insights provides analytics, observability, and performance monitoring resources for Cloudflare-powered applications and infrastructure.

Cloudflare Insights spans analytics, logs, observability, web performance, and developer monitoring across Cloudflare’s platform. The most useful resources are primarily hosted within Cloudflare’s developer and product documentation.

## Analytics & Observability
- [Cloudflare Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/): Overview of traffic, security, and performance analytics across Cloudflare products.
- [Analytics Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/analytics-engine/): Serverless SQL analytics database for ingesting and querying event data.
- [Browser Insights](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-insights/): Real user monitoring for page load performance and user experience metrics.
- [Cloudflare Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/): Export and analyze request, security, and network logs from Cloudflare.
- [Log Explorer](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/log-explorer/): Search and inspect Cloudflare logs directly in the dashboard.
- [GraphQL Analytics API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/): Query Cloudflare analytics datasets using GraphQL.
- [Observability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/): Monitor Workers applications with logs, traces, and metrics.

## Performance & Web Monitoring
- [Speed](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/): Tools and guidance for measuring and improving website performance.
- [Web Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/): Privacy-focused website analytics without client-side cookies.
- [Browser Rendering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-rendering/): Run headless browser workloads on Cloudflare’s network.
- [Image Resizing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/image-resizing/): Transform and optimize images at the edge for performance.
- [Polish](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/optimization/content/polish/): Compress and optimize images automatically for faster delivery.
- [Auto Minify](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/optimization/content/troubleshooting/auto-minify/): Reduce asset size by minifying HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Rocket Loader](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/optimization/content/rocket-loader/): Improve page rendering by asynchronously loading JavaScript resources.

## Logs, Metrics & Data Pipelines
- [Logpush](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/): Export Cloudflare logs to storage, SIEM, and analytics destinations.
- [Logpull API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpull/): Retrieve HTTP request logs through Cloudflare’s REST API.
- [HTTP Requests Adaptive Groups](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/features/http-requests-adaptive-groups/): Aggregate request analytics with flexible dimensions and filters.
- [Magic Network Monitoring](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-network-monitoring/): Network telemetry and DDoS visibility for on-premises and hybrid environments.
- [Network Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-transit/network-analytics/): Analyze traffic patterns and attack visibility for network protection products.
- [Cloudforce One Datasets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudforce-one/datasets/): Access threat intelligence datasets for security analysis workflows.

## APIs & Reference
- [Cloudflare API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/): REST API reference for managing Cloudflare products and account resources.
- [GraphQL API Reference](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/features/): Reference for available analytics datasets and query features.
- [API Tokens](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/): Create scoped API tokens for secure programmatic access.
- [Audit Logs API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/user/subresources/audit_logs/): Access account audit log events through the Cloudflare API.
- [Radar API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/investigate/api/): Programmatic access to Internet traffic and trend data from Cloudflare Radar.
- [Workers Analytics Engine API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/analytics-engine/): Reference and usage guidance for writing and querying analytics data.

## Workers Monitoring
- [Workers Observability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/): Central entry point for logs, traces, metrics, and debugging tools.
- [Workers Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/logs/): Capture and inspect runtime logs from Workers applications.
- [Workers Traces](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/traces/): Distributed tracing support for Workers-based services.
- [Workers Metrics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/metrics-and-analytics/): View invocation, error, and performance metrics for Workers.
- [Tail Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/logs/tail-workers/): Stream Worker events for debugging and operational visibility.
- [Wrangler](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/): CLI for developing, deploying, and debugging Workers applications.

## Security Analytics
- [Cloudflare Radar](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/): Internet traffic trends, attack insights, and global network intelligence.
- [Security Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/analytics/): Analyze firewall events, threats, and mitigation activity.
- [DDoS Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ddos-protection/ddos-analytics/): Review attack traffic, mitigations, and event timelines.
- [Bot Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/additional-configurations/bot-analytics/): Inspect bot traffic, scores, and mitigation outcomes.
- [API Shield Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api-shield/security/analytics/): Monitor API security events and protection effectiveness.
- [Zero Trust Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/): Visibility into Zero Trust traffic, users, and policy activity.

## Guides & Tutorials
- [Get Started with Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/get-started/): Learn how to access and use Cloudflare analytics products.
- [Querying with the GraphQL API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/getting-started/): Build analytics queries against Cloudflare datasets.
- [Set up Browser Insights](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-insights/get-started/): Enable real user monitoring for web applications.
- [Set up Web Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/get-started/): Add privacy-first analytics tracking to a website.
- [Set up Logpush](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/get-started/): Configure log exports to supported destinations.
- [Use Analytics Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/analytics-engine/get-started/): Ingest and query event data with Analytics Engine.

## Platform & Product Context
- [Developer Documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/): Main portal for Cloudflare product documentation and references.
- [Fundamentals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/): Core concepts for accounts, zones, APIs, and platform configuration.
- [Learning Center](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/): Explanations of networking, security, and performance concepts.
- [Cloudflare Blog](https://blog.cloudflare.com/): Product announcements, engineering deep dives, and platform updates.
- [Status](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/): Service health and incident reporting for Cloudflare systems.
- [Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/): Recent documentation and product update history.
